section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement instruments used in the current study, including the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for assessing body appreciation, the MBSRQ-AE for appearance evaluation, the MEIM for ethnic identity, the RSES for self-esteem, the SATAQ-3 for sociocultural attitudes toward appearance, the EAT-26 Dieting Subscale for eating attitudes, the EDE-Q for eating disorder symptoms, and the PARTS for weight/size teasing experiences. A Demographics Questionnaire was also created to collect participant information including age, year in school, ethnicity, gender, height, and weight. BMI was assessed via self-reported height and weight.
